name: BookLeaf – AI-Powered Author Royalty Summary Automation

nodes.name: Webhook – Receive Request
nodes.notes: POST /bookleaf/royalty-summary. Authenticated with the X-BookLeaf-Secret header (Header Auth credential). Wrong or missing secret is rejected by n8n with 403 before the workflow runs.

nodes.name: Workflow Config
nodes.notes: Single place to configure BUBBLE_BASE_URL (Bubble Data API root, ending in /api/1.1) and BUBBLE_CALLBACK_URL (Bubble backend workflow endpoint). No secrets here: tokens live in n8n credentials.

nodes.name: Validate Request
nodes.notes: Checks JSON content type and that author_id, request_id and triggered_by are present. The secret header itself is verified by the Webhook node credential.

nodes.name: Check Duplicate Request
nodes.notes: Persistent duplicate guard. A request is a duplicate if Bubble shows Success, or n8n static data (persists across production executions) shows it is Processing (under 30 min) or Success. Failed requests may be retried.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: "Duplicate", request_id: $json.request_id || "", summary: "", error_message: $json.duplicate_reason || "Duplicate request", email_status: "not_attempted", email_error: "", subject: "", email_to: "", totals_match: false, completed_at: $now.toISO() }) }}

nodes.name: Respond – Duplicate Request
nodes.notes: No callback is sent for duplicates, so the original Notification Log record is never overwritten.

nodes.name: Prepare Royalty Data
nodes.notes: Builds one structured object per author and splits books into Published and In Production. Original Bubble values are preserved; nothing is invented. Throws if author or books are missing so the failure branch runs.

nodes.name: Calculate Royalty Totals
nodes.notes: Sums earned, paid and pending royalty from the Bubble values; copies sold counts published books only; latest payout date is the most recent non-empty payout date.

nodes.name: Check Royalty Status
nodes.notes: FULLY PAID when pending is 0. OVERDUE when pending > 0 and the latest payout is over 90 days old, or a published book older than 90 days with pending royalty never had a payout (same 90-day rule as Bubble). Otherwise PENDING. Uses the current date.

messageValues.message:
You are an experienced author relationship manager at BookLeaf Publishing.

Your task is to generate a personalized, professional, warm, and easy-to-understand royalty summary email for an author.

Follow these rules:

1. Address the author by their first name.
2. Use a warm and professional tone.
3. Include every published book with its title, copies sold, royalty earned, royalty paid, and royalty pending.
4. Clearly show total royalty earned, total royalty paid, and total pending royalty.
5. Explain pending payouts using BookLeaf's quarterly payout policy.
6. According to BookLeaf's policy, royalties are paid quarterly within 45 days, subject to a minimum payout threshold of ₹1,000. Amounts below the threshold roll over to the next payout cycle.
7. If all royalties are paid, acknowledge this positively.
8. Mention the production status of unpublished books.
9. Never promise a specific payment date unless supported by the supplied information.
10. Never invent sales, payout dates, or financial figures.
11. Do not expose internal system information.
12. Use Indian Rupees (₹).
13. Do not mention AI or automation.
14. Make the email readable with clear headings and bullet points.

The generated email must include:

Subject: Your BookLeaf Royalty Summary

Email Body:

- Personalized greeting.
- Brief introduction.
- Book-wise royalty summary.
- Consolidated royalty totals.
- Pending payment explanation, if applicable.
- Production updates, if applicable.
- Positive closing message.
- BookLeaf Publishing Support Team signature.

nodes.name: OpenAI – Generate Royalty Summary
nodes.notes: Generates the royalty email with the OpenAI Chat Model (gpt-4o-mini) from the real Bubble figures only.

nodes.name: Validate AI Response
nodes.notes: Rejects empty text, text missing the author name or subject line, and text that looks like an error or refusal. The full email body is preserved unchanged.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: "Rejected", request_id: $json.request_id || "", summary: "", error_message: ($json.errors || []).join("; "), email_status: "not_attempted", email_error: "", subject: "", email_to: "", totals_match: false, completed_at: $now.toISO() }) }}

nodes.name: Build Email HTML
nodes.notes: Builds the professional HTML email (greeting, totals, book-wise table, last and next payout) around the AI-written summary.

nodes.name: Real Email Enabled?
nodes.notes: Dry-run switch. email_enabled is false in Workflow Config, so no real email is sent until you set it to true.

nodes.name: Send Email
nodes.notes: Only runs when email_enabled is true. Needs an SMTP credential. If email_test_recipient is set, every email goes to that address instead of the author.

nodes.name: Build Success Response
nodes.notes: Marks the request as done (blocks duplicate sends), works out the email status and builds the JSON returned to Bubble.

nodes.name: Build Failure Response
nodes.notes: Single entry point for every failure (bad data, OpenAI error, invalid AI text). Releases the duplicate lock so the request can be retried, and builds the error JSON returned to Bubble.

nodeGroups.name: Validate request
nodeGroups.description: Holds the Bubble URLs, then checks the incoming call has a JSON body with author, request and admin IDs before anything runs

nodeGroups.name: Prevent duplicates
nodeGroups.description: Looks up the request ID in Bubble and n8n memory so the same request never produces a second summary

nodeGroups.name: Work out royalty status
nodeGroups.description: Totals earned, paid and pending royalty, then labels the author Fully Paid, Pending or Overdue (90-day rule)

nodeGroups.name: Check summary quality
nodeGroups.description: Confirms the generated email is real text, names the author and is not an error before it is sent
